verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents its own bulk capabilities: simulations generated from real tickets run in bulk batches with side-by-side comparisons across hundreds of scenarios, historical tickets can be replayed in bulk, and knowledge bases can be audited at scale through the MCP server. These are bulk analysis and testing operations, not general bulk actions on items. Missing for 10: bulk edit/update/delete actions across tickets, articles or workflows; documented batch limits or bulk APIs; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Generate simulations straight from your actual tickets and run them in bulk batches
Side-by-side batch comparisons show how a workflow edit changed outcomes across hundreds of scenarios
Replay historical tickets and synthetic scenarios in bulk to see projected resolution quality and knowledge gaps
Audit knowledge bases - analyze articles at scale, find gaps, and spot quality issues
